Geoscientific data acquisition, geological surveys, geohazard assessments

professional_registration_requirements.SACNASP: Statutory registration mandatory for all geoscientists practicing in South Africa under the Natural Scientific Professions Act. Required for Competent Person sign-off on SAMREC-compliant reports.
professional_registration_requirements.ECSA: Statutory registration required for engineers performing identified engineering work under the Engineering Profession Act 46 of 2000. Required for rock and geotechnical engineers.
professional_registration_requirements.GSSA_SAIMM_membership: Professional membership of the Geological Society of South Africa (GSSA) or the Southern African Institute of Mining and Metallurgy (SAIMM) is recognised as qualifying a practitioner as a Competent Person under SAMREC.
professional_registration_requirements.CIDB_grading: CIDB (Construction Industry Development Board) grading applies primarily to construction contractors, not professional consulting services. However, consulting firms contracted by CIDB-regulated projects may need to demonstrate alignment with grading requirements. Professional service providers (geology, geotechnics) typically register under the EP (Engineering and Professional) category.
professional_registration_requirements.BBBEE: Broad-Based Black Economic Empowerment compliance scoring is a standard evaluation criterion in government and SOE tenders, typically weighted under the Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act (PPPFA).
professional_registration_requirements.CSD_registration: All suppliers to government must be registered on the Central Supplier Database (csd.gov.za).
